```python
def merge(self, ranges, gap=0):
    if not ranges:
        return []
    ordered = sorted(tuple(r) for r in ranges)  # sort by lo then hi
    merged = [list(ordered[0])]
    for lo, hi in ordered[1:]:
        cur = merged[-1]
        missing = lo - cur[1] - 1
        if missing <= gap:
            if hi > cur[1]:
                cur[1] = hi
        else:
            merged.append([lo, hi])
```

```python
class Impl:
    def parse(self, argv):
        values = {}
        flags = {}
        positional = []
        i = 0
        n = len(argv)
        terminated = False
        while i < n:
            tok = argv[i]
            if terminated:
                positional.append(tok)
                i += 1
                continue
            if tok == "--":
                terminated = True
                i += 1
                continue
            if tok.startswith("--") and len(tok) > 2:
                body = tok[2:]
                if "=" in body:
                    key, val = body.split("=", 1)
                    values.setdefault(key, []).append(val)
                    i += 1
                    continue
                key = body
                # check next
                if i + 1 < n and not argv[i+1].startswith("--"):
                    values.setdefault(key, []).append(argv[i+1])
                    i += 2
                else:
                    flags[key] = True
                    i += 1
                continue
            if tok.startswith("-") and len(tok) > 1 and not tok.startswith("--"):
                # bundled short switches, e.g. -abc
                for ch in tok[1:]:
                    flags[ch] = True
                i += 1
                continue
            # positional: not starting with "-", or exactly "-"
            positional.append(tok)
            i += 1
        return {"values": values, "flags": flags, "positional": positional}
```
